THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON(1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS an Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour which accompanies this order exists between,
Public Service National Health Service Union, Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital, Thalapathpitiya, Nugegoda
and

Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital Board, Thalapathpitiya, Nugegoda NOW THEREFORE I, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Act, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes-Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby

Colombo.16th September, 2025.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON(1956 REVISED EDITION)
Public Service National Health Service Union, Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital, Thalapathpitiya, Nugegoda
and
Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital Board, Thalapathpitiya, Nugegoda
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether the 188 orderlies (Attendents) mentioned in Annexure - 01, employed in the Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital Board have been caused injustice by the steps taken to place them in salary code PL - 1 from 01.01.2006 in accordance with Public Administration Circular 6/2006 and if so, to what relief they are entitled.
H. M. D. N. K. Wataliyadda, Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, on this 03rd day of September, 2025.
